variants.headline: Party names a new leader
variants.body: The party {party} has a new leader: {new}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Leadership changes hands
variants.body: Leadership of {party} has changed, with {new} the new leader. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A new name at the head of the party
variants.body: The new leader of {party} is {new}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
